source: BK3 printed pp.38-39 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.45; wire list image-read on PDF p.45 at 300 dpi (six lines); Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Speculative (Step 7): every expect is derived by hand from the wiring and the p.39 rule A X B + C = D (pushbuttons 1, 2, 3 represent A, B, C; light 4 represents D); the page prints no lamp state for any button combination. Wire list: the page image and the PDF text layer both print six lines, 1+/1Y, 1Y/3Y, 1X/2Y, 2X/3X, 3X/4A, 4B/4-, and the circuit diagram agrees (1+ to 1Y). programs.json wiresCorrected/wiresEffective and programs.md list five, dropping 1+/1Y (the same '+' glyph OCR break as III-NOT); without it nothing reaches plus and light 4 can never light. This fixture wires the six printed lines; the corpus record is not edited here. Topology: pushbutton arm Y, N.O. X (jack-map, Book I p.8). Series branch 1+-1Y-1X-2Y-2X (A and B, N.O. contacts) in parallel with 1Y-3Y-3X (C, N.O.), both into 3X-4A, lamp 4, 4B-4-. ER-08 inserts THEN in the p.38 prose only; no wire change. The 300 ms advance before each expect is a script choice for the lamp's thermal transient; the page states no timing.
